title: rwlock with a Live Reader Count
prompt: Given: a `pthread_rwlock_t` and `int active_readers`. Implement `void lock_read(void)` (rdlock AND increment active_readers), `void unlock_read(void)` (decrement, then unlock), `void lock_write(void)` / `void unlock_write(void)` wrapping wrlock. The metric is how tests observe concurrency — keep it truthful.

tests.name: reader count tracks
tests.hint: Two readers hold the lock simultaneously — rdlock allows that — and the count follows exactly.

tests.name: write path works
tests.hint: The write path locks and releases without touching the reader metric.
